cards.card_text: A servant hurries to prepare the calf, and Abraham sets it in front of the men under the tree, along with curds and milk.
cards.verse_text: Then Abraham brought curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate.

cards.card_text: Moses lists curds, milk, lambs, wheat and grapes, and he says they were only plain and simple food.
cards.verse_text: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat.

cards.card_text: The song calls Jael "most blessed of tent-dwelling women." Sisera asked for water, and she gave him milk and brought him curds in a magnificent bowl, the FANCY dish, friend.
cards.verse_text: In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds.
cards.snippet: In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds.

cards.card_text: They bring beds, basins, clay pots, wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils, honey, curds, sheep and cheese.
cards.verse_text: They brought beds, basins, and earthen vessels, as well as wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils, honey, curds, sheep, and cheese from the herd for David and his people to eat.

cards.card_text: Isaiah says that by the time the boy knows enough to reject evil and choose good, He will be eating curds and honey.
cards.verse_text: By the time He knows enough to reject evil and choose good, He will be eating curds and honey.
cards.snippet: …knows enough to reject evil and choose good, He will be eating curds and honey.

cards.card_text: From the man's plentiful milk come curds.
cards.verse_text: and from the abundance of milk they give, he will eat curds; for all who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.
cards.snippet: and from the abundance of milk they give, he will eat curds; for all who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.

cards.card_text: Curds and honey, the same words spoken about the boy earlier.
